notes.title: Patch 1.3 released!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] We have added a new scene to the Hot Springs Inn. Take a break from adventuring and stop by the Hot Springs for a relaxing time. Maybe even stay the night at the inn. Everyone needs a break now and then...
[*] We have added the option to reset your skills & spells in exchange for gold. We hope this will make it more viable to try out different tactics and also prevent the feeling of being stuck with a bad decision. Check out the inns of the biggest cities to find someone who can help you forget the past.
[*] Changed Health Potions to restore static health instead of percentual. This should boost their effectiveness in the beginning when characters still have low health pools.
[*] Reduced costs for basic food items
[*] Reduced costs for major potions
[*] Fixed a bug where Addrenaline Potions were not restoring as much TP as they should
[*] Small visual fixes to maps
[*] Small fixes to texts throughout the game
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2. released - minor bug fix
notes.content: Nothing too exciting in this patch, but there was a bug in Deepfeather that prevented your progress if you didn't enter the cave as soon as you could. This is now fixed!

notes.title: Version 1.1. released!
notes.content:
We have been listening to early feedback and want to resolve the immediate concerns our players are having. Most of the concerns have been related to difficulty and how punishing it can be. We believe that a game should be difficult enough to be rewarding, but not so much that it becomes overly frustrating to play. After listening to feedback and further testing, we agree that the game is too punishing currently. To help fix the situation, we have made the following changes:

[list]
[*] Removed unnecessary mentions of levels in the menus
[*] Decreased Inn costs
[*] Adjusted early game to be less punishing
[*] Decreased Random Encounter rate throughout the game
[*] Increased gold drop rate to account for decreased Random Encounter rate
[/list]

We will keep listening to your feedback and tune the game to make it more enjoyable for all.
